blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — In the bustling, tightly knit community of Barangay Maguikay, Mandaue City, emergencies rarely wait for a convenient hour. Whether it was a routine day at the barangay hall or a sudden fire siren cutting through the night, residents knew one man they could consistently count on to answer the call: Floranti Cavan Delima. Today, the corridors of the Maguikay barangay hall feel noticeably quieter, and a heavy pall of grief hangs over the neighborhood.
